name: k3
description: UNOFFICIAL BRILIA fork of linxule/kimi-plugin-cc, developed and verified on Windows 11, running on macOS and Linux as well. Delegates review, challenge, ask, rescue, pursue, and swarm workflows to the local kimi-code CLI through the k3-plugin-cc companion runtime. Not affiliated with Moonshot AI.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate repo work to local kimi-code
interface.longDescription: Shell-only Codex packaging for k3-plugin-cc. It exposes Codex skills that call the existing companion runtime and local kimi-code subprocess, while preserving the Claude Code plugin surface.
defaultPrompt: Use $k3-review to review my current diff.
Use $k3-ask to explain this repository flow.
Use $k3-rescue to delegate a bounded fix.
